free_tier.stated: Tagline: 'Share large files anonymously. Unlimited storage. No mail required. No speed limit. No size limit.' No numeric quota page found.

egress.terms: Claims no speed limit; no GB meter published.

tooling: No documented API; the endpoints found in the page source (/api/complete, /api/get, /api/upload-url) reject naive curl with an HTML error page, so a browser/session is required.
chaining: Anonymous, no-mail, no-size-limit uploads — the same shape as Buzzheavier/ZeroFS. Retention policy is unpublished, which is the risk.
limits_note: Unpublished per-file and retention terms; only the marketing claims are visible without a session.
reliability_note: Cannot be verified past the landing page: no FAQ, no terms, upload endpoints return 'File not found' HTML to scripted POSTs. Treat the unlimited claim as unverified marketing.

evidence.proved: meta description 'Unlimited storage. No mail required. No speed limit. No size limit.'
probe: POST -F file=@vk2.txt -> 200 text/html 'File not found' (no JSON API)
